info.description: This is the Fusion Cloud Backend API server providing comprehensive role-based access control, user management, and project management capabilities.
info.title: Fusion Cloud Backend API

get.description: Get access and ID tokens for a user using Resource Owner Password flow (QA/Staging environment only)
get.summary: Get Auth0 tokens for automation testing

get.description: Returns a paginated list of firmware releases with optional filtering by platform and minimum version. Results are ordered by version in descending order.

parameters.description: Minimum version filter - returns only versions newer than this (e.g., '1.0.1')
parameters.name: min_version

200.description: List of firmware releases with pagination metadata

post.description: Creates a new firmware release entry in draft status and returns a presigned S3 URL for uploading the firmware artifact. The upload URL is valid for 15 minutes.

parameters.description: Firmware release metadata including version, platform, release notes, etc.
parameters.name: request

200.description: Returns releaseId and presignedUrl for artifact upload

400.description: Invalid request payload or version already exists

post.description: Deploys an 'AVAILABLE' firmware release to a specific distribution channel (dev, testing, stable).

parameters.description: Unique identifier of the firmware release
parameters.name: releaseID

post.description: Updates the release status to 'AVAILABLE' and creates a deployment entry for the specified channel, making the firmware available for devices to download

parameters.description: Unique identifier of the firmware release
parameters.name: releaseID

post.description: Checks if newer firmware versions are available for a batch of devices based on their current versions, platform, and deployment channel. Returns update availability status and latest version information for each device.

parameters.description: List of devices with their current firmware versions and platform information
parameters.name: request

200.description: Update availability results for each device

post.description: Records the success or failure of a firmware update installation on a device. This endpoint is called by devices after attempting a firmware update.

parameters.description: Firmware update log details including device ID, version, and status
parameters.name: request

400.description: Invalid request payload or status value

get.description: Generates a presigned S3 URL for downloading a specific firmware release artifact. The URL is valid for 15 minutes and includes the file checksum for integrity verification.

200.description: Presigned download URL and file checksum

404.description: Firmware release not found for the specified platform and version

get.description: Get comprehensive role management data including roles, features, access levels, and users for the organization

401.description: Unauthorized - User email not found in token

403.description: Forbidden - Insufficient permissions for role management

post.description: Create a new role with the specified name and description in the organization

401.description: Unauthorized - User email not found in token

403.description: Forbidden - Insufficient permissions to create roles

put.description: Update the permissions assigned to a specific role within the organization

400.description: Bad request - Invalid JSON payload or invalid role ID

401.description: Unauthorized - User email not found in token

403.description: Forbidden - Insufficient permissions to update role permissions

get.description: Get all users within the organization along with their role information

401.description: Unauthorized - User email not found in token

403.description: Forbidden - Insufficient permissions to view organization users

put.description: Update the role assignment for a specific user within the organization

400.description: Bad request - Invalid JSON payload or missing user ID

401.description: Unauthorized - User email not found in token

403.description: Forbidden - Insufficient permissions to update user roles

get.description: Get all available products including speakers, amplifiers, DSPs, controllers, and endpoints
Get a specific product by its unique identifier

400.description: Bad request - Product ID is required

get.description: Get prices for a specific product by its unique identifier, optionally filtered by currency

parameters.description: Currency code (e.g., USD, EUR) to filter prices
parameters.name: currency

400.description: Bad request - Product ID is required

get.description: Get all projects in the system

parameters.description: Field to sort projects by (e.g., created_at, updated_at)
parameters.name: sort_by

post.description: Create a new project in the system

400.description: Bad request - Invalid payload or user not found or project Id already exists

delete.description: Delete a project by its unique identifier

403.description: Forbidden - User not assigned to project, project archived, or locked by another user

patch.description: Update an existing project by its ID

403.description: Forbidden - User not assigned to project, project archived, or locked by another user

post.description: Archive or unarchive a project based on request body

403.description: Forbidden - User not assigned to project or project locked by another user

post.description: Lock or unlock a project for a specific user based on request body

403.description: Forbidden - User not assigned to project or project already locked by another user

post.description: Star or unstar a project for a specific user based on request body

403.description: Forbidden - User not assigned to project, project archived, or locked by another user

put.description: Assign a user to a project by project ID and user email
put.summary: Assign a user to a project

204.description: User successfully assigned to the project

delete.description: Remove a user from a project by project ID and user email
delete.summary: Remove a user from a project

204.description: User successfully removed from the project

404.description: Project or User not found, or user not assigned to the project

post.description: Create a new user with the specified details

get.description: Get authorization details including user info, account, role, and permissions for the current authenticated user

401.description: Unauthorized - User email not found in token

404.description: User not found in the system

get.description: Get profile for a specific user
get.summary: Get user profile by user ID

404.description: User profile not found / Invalid user ID format

post.description: Create a new user profile with the provided details

put.description: Update an existing user profile with the provided details

get.description: Get settings for a specific user
get.summary: Get user settings by user ID

404.description: User settings not found / Invalid user ID format

post.description: Create a new user settings with the provided details

put.description: Update an existing user settings with the provided details

get.description: Get a specific user by their email address

patch.description: Update an existing user's information by their ID
